components.title: Actions
components.purpose: Trigger an action or navigate using a correctly typed element.
requirements: Use a button for actions and an anchor for navigation.
Set type=button outside submission actions.
Keep a visible label or accessible name; explain disabled actions.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Fields
components.purpose: Collect a labeled value with help and error feedback.
requirements: Associate a visible label with each control.
Link help and error text through aria-describedby.
Use aria-invalid=true only for an actual error.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Select
components.purpose: Choose one option using native keyboard and form behavior.
requirements: Wrap the select in u-select within u-field.
Browser picker styling is progressive; unsupported browsers retain native menus.
Searchable combobox behavior is not included.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Confirmation dialog
components.purpose: Review a consequential action in a native modal dialog.
requirements: Use showModal through the optional interaction controller.
Provide aria-labelledby and an explicit cancel button.
Initialize focus on the least destructive action.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Data table
components.purpose: Display comparable records with column and row semantics.
requirements: Use headers with scope and a named keyboard-reachable scroll region.
Optional collection controller supplies title search, status filtering and title sorting. Pagination remains application-owned.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Panel
components.purpose: Group related content into a readable surface.
requirements: Provide a heading for meaningful sections.
Avoid nested cards when a divider would suffice.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Status
components.purpose: Communicate state with text, not color alone.
requirements: Do not infer verification or authorization from a status color.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Feedback
components.purpose: Explain an outcome or recovery action.
requirements: Describe what happened and what the user can do next.
Use live announcements for dynamic events only.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Empty state
components.purpose: Explain why a collection has no content and how to proceed.
requirements: Distinguish no data from no matching results and failed requests.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Labeled facts
components.purpose: Display stable details including financial and property information.
requirements: Unknown and missing are not zero.
Keep units and estimated values explicit.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Progress
components.purpose: Show task completion without relying on color.
requirements: Use accessible progress values and text.
Respect reduced motion. For animated native progress, use optional UniformInteractions.setProgress(element, value); accessible values update immediately.
Progress is not license approval.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Navigation
components.purpose: Locate the current view and expose destinations.
requirements: Use aria-current=page for the current route and aria-current=location for the current section.
Use aria-pressed for buttons that select an in-page preview.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Document selection
components.purpose: Inspect a locally selected document before application upload.
requirements: This controller validates metadata only, never file contents.
Applications must validate and authorize files on the server.
Announce selection and errors.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Person or firm
components.purpose: Summarize a person or organization and their relationship.
requirements: Use placeholder identity data in fixtures.
Show role and relationship explicitly.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Activity timeline
components.purpose: Display a sequence of labeled events.
requirements: Use real timestamps in applications and distinguish them from due dates.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.

components.title: Property facts
components.purpose: Present property information without assuming listing or map services.
requirements: Use explicit units and missing-value labels.
No geocoding or listing provider is included.
Self-host dist/ at /design/ or change the sample image URL to your asset mount. Replace the illustrative photo for real listings.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending for this local change.
Photos are AI-generated samples, not real listings.

components.title: Context menu
components.purpose: Offer contextual actions through a native popover.
requirements: Load context-menu.css and context-menu.js; call UniformContextMenu.mount(root).
Use named buttons with menuitem roles and data-u-context-action. Handle uniform:context-action on the trigger.
Provide a visible opener and equivalent ordinary actions. Browser context menus remain available outside opted-in controls.
limitations: Browser and assistive-technology verification pending.

patterns.title: Multi-step intake
patterns.purpose: Validate before advancing; retain values on Back; focus each new step heading; announce save failure.
requirements: Validate before advancing; retain values on Back; focus each new step heading; announce save failure.
Replace fixture copy and persistence with application-owned data and policy.
Use data-u-stepper, data-u-step, data-u-next, data-u-back and data-u-step-count hooks. Listen to uniform:step-change to render a review and uniform:complete to submit through application code.
Mount one stepper per root; keep its data-u-step-list in that root. Application owns draft persistence and completion side effects.
limitations: Fixture controllers are examples; application backend, authorization and regulatory rules are not supplied.

requirements: Combine search and status filters; announce result count; Clear restores all records and focuses search.

patterns.title: Component state fixtures

patterns.title: Map and list
patterns.purpose: Keep property selection and filtering consistent between an accessible list and a map.
requirements: Keep records without coordinates in the list.
The optional sample shortlist is held only for the mounted page lifetime. Expose its toggle with aria-pressed and announce changes; never imply saved server data.
Clear selection when a filter removes the selected result.
Provide keyboard access and a list alternative to map markers.
Label fictional data and preserve provider attribution in any live integration.
Hover and focus preview the counterpart without changing selection.
Keep structured selection details available in both mobile views. Escape and Clear selection dismiss and restore focus to the visible initiating control.
Loading and renderer failure must preserve the list, filters and selected record. Announce renderer status separately from result counts.
Retry changes renderer state only; restore focus when the retry control is removed.
Call UniformMapList.connect(root, options) once per root; destroy the returned connection before removing its DOM.
Provide unique record ids matching data-property attributes; nullable [latitude, longitude] locations; text-only title and label.
Omit provider to use OpenFreeMap. Override provider.style or provider.lightStyle/darkStyle and optionally provider.transformRequest for another service.
Keep source attribution visible. Allow the chosen provider origins in CSP; never put secret server credentials in frontend configuration.
Group overlapping markers by default; counts include only visible located records. Activation zooms into a group; identical coordinates or maximum zoom open keyboard-accessible member choices.
Cluster selection indicators include a selected member; filtering recomputes groups and dismisses stale member choices.
limitations: Default OpenFreeMap basemap requests go to tiles.openfreemap.org; network access and WebGL are required.
No backend, geocoder or live listings service is included.
Only MapLibre-compatible styles work with the default adapter. Other renderer SDKs need an adapter; an explicit Leaflet option remains available.
Screen-space clustering is intended for modest frontend collections; server-scale indexing and viewport queries are outside scope.
Browser/CSP and actual provider rendering verification remain pending.

options.maplibre: import * as maplibre from the packaged vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl.mjs module
options.provider: Optional {style: URL|StyleSpecification} or {lightStyle,darkStyle}; optional transformRequest for browser-safe request configuration. Default: OpenFreeMap.
options.renderer: Optional adapter implementing mount(root, options); default UniformMapLibre. Use UniformMap explicitly for the separately loaded Leaflet adapter.
options.clustering: Optional boolean, defaults to true. Screen-space overlap grouping; false shows individual markers.

integration.initialization: maplibre.setWorkerUrl(new URL("./vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs", import.meta.url).href); const connection = UniformMapList.connect(root, {maplibre, records});
integration.csp: script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://tiles.openfreemap.org; img-src 'self' blob: https://tiles.openfreemap.org
notes: Serve over HTTP(S). Network map requests are enabled by the default provider.
Leaflet alternative: load vendor/leaflet.js, vendor/leaflet.css and map.js, then pass renderer: UniformMap, leaflet: L and an abortable GeoJSON source function.
Use unique HTML ids when composing multiple roots.
Provider styles are trusted application configuration. Custom providers may require public API keys, attribution and additional CSP origins.
Map libraries remain optional assets, separate from core design.css.
Call UniformContextMenu.mount(root) for optional card actions. Gallery controls preserve selection and filters; settings change columns and card density.

patterns.title: Application Shell
patterns.purpose: Standard layout framework for Uniform web applications, including responsive navigation and workspace areas.
requirements: Always use u-app as the top-level container.
Mobile navigation uses a <details> element for the collapsible menu.
Include both light and dark theme brand marks.
limitations: Theme toggle requires client-side JavaScript (e.g. theme.js) for logic.

patterns.title: Map Preview
patterns.purpose: A simple, read-only map embed for displaying a single property location.
requirements: Provide data-lat and data-lng attributes on the canvas.
Initialize with UniformMapLibre or Leaflet adapter.
limitations: Does not include clustering or linked list filtering.

rules: Use semantic --u-* variables and documented u-* classes.
Use the native element that supplies the required semantics.
Do not assume a preview component is certified or stable.
Keep application policy and server authorization out of the design package.
